name: Ichetucknee Springs Campground (private)
area: Fort White, by the Ichetucknee North Entrance
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 23, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: 245 SW Breckenridge Lane, Fort White, FL 32038
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: An old-Florida private campground under big oaks, with bathrooms, showers and a game room. Primitive tent sites have no power or water at the site (there is community water around the grounds and outlets in the main building around the clock); tent sites with power are 20-amp. Regular rates for two people: $30 primitive, $40 tent with power, $50 RV, plus tax and a one-time $5 booking fee. Thanksgiving rates apply Thursday to Saturday: $40 primitive and $50 tent with power. Booking is by phone only, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., (386) 497-2285. Cash, Venmo, Zelle, Apple Pay and Google Pay have no fee; cards add 3%. The rules do not mention sleeping in a car, so ask when you call. It is not part of the state park.
cost: $30 to $40 a night for two (Thanksgiving Thu-Sat: $40 to $50), plus tax and a $5 booking fee
access: Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 2 p.m. Arrivals after 6 p.m. are arranged by phone. Quiet time 11 p.m. Sites are assigned on arrival. Prepaid holiday bookings get no cash refund if cancelled.

conditions.summary: Operator home, rates and rules pages read November 23, 2026. Thanksgiving-week availability was not checked (booking is by phone only). (source dated 2026-11-23)
